8.3.111 EthIf_MacSecUpdateRxSa
[SWS_EthIf_91214]{DRAFT} Definition of API function EthIf_MacSecUpdateRxSa
⌈
Service Name
EthIf_MacSecUpdateRxSa (DRAFT)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_MacSecUpdateRxSa (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
uint8 An,
uint64 LowestPn,
boolean Active
)
Service ID [hex]
0x82
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, Non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx
CtrlIdx
Index of the Ethernet controller within the context of the Ethernet
Interface
An
Association Number to use in the MACsec’s reception secure
association
LowestPn
Lowest accepted Packet Number in the MACsec’s reception
secure association
Parameters (in)
Active
Boolean to enable/disable the MACsec’s reception secure
association
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request
has not been accepted
Description
Request the Ethernet Inferface (MACsec per SW) or the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to update
the Reception Secure Association with the given Packet Number. The Active parameter is
included to change the specified AN status.
Tags: atp.Status=DRAFT
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋()
